profiles_not_run.reason: Owner choice 01: credentialed/paid execution requires a separate run; no run is authorized here.
Owner choice 01: historical engine-limit, heap and timing studies retained in the pinned inventory; individual semantic mappings/command adapters remain pending P1. No execution credit.

limits: K1.4 ranges A and B (owner release 01; owner choices 01 and 02; design 01 as changed by design 02). Range A: the legacy Driver over the 0.8.x Harness, its lineage scheduler, root identity scope, codec and lineage classifier, the SDK host that owns the in-process coordinator, the Kernel-routed SDK methods, the deprecated Harness view, the option dispositions, the private SDK manifest, the builder-docs admission and the legacy-bridge zone with its K14-3 rules. Range B: the K14-4 inventory (packages/sdk/tests/bridge-inventory.test.ts), the K14-5 wrapper export with the L-01 check (wrapper.ts, value-capture.ts, wrapper-environment.test.ts), the K14-6 mapping (tests/conformance/legacy-mapping.json, architecture/legacy-mapping.test.ts, X-row header notes), the guides, the SDK README, the builder skill, Layer 3, BASELINE and 017.

The bridge corpus is the B-* tests in packages/sdk/tests/bridge-*.test.ts. B-QUIESCE-CELLS is a declared bounded search over forged records (the record model): lifecycle x wait kind x pending operation (effect kind, dispatch, confirmation) x resumption state for one member and for a parent waiting on a call child; and, from round 2 (design 03), one operation's effect kind x status x dispatch x outcome x confirmation state x lifecycle x wait kind x resumption state (none, pending, settled, invalidated), plus two operations per member over every pair of six verdict classes; nothing outside that product is claimed. K14-4's closure is a declared bounded search: the SDK's exports and the members of its SDK-declared exported types (one level into anonymous, mapped and utility-typed members), the 35 Harness methods, and the backticked SDK and Harness members, sdk imports and example files of the guide pages reachable from docs/guides/README.md, the SDK README, the builder skill and examples/execution-kernel-minimal.

No Kernel source changes: packages/kernel/src is preserved at B. packages/kernel/tests/binding-surface.test.ts restates three BINDING-01 assertions with their kept properties (design 02 D01-CHK-06): the capture graph imports no Kernel, the public runtime keys are the new exact list, and the capture prefix is byte-identical to B apart from the L-01 call.
The adoption manifest's preserved table is regenerated mechanically by TOOLS-02's regenerate in a fresh clone; no new credit.

Round 2 (review 01 K14-R1-01..05; design 03 with its addendum after design check 03; owner choice 04): the validated double-collect observation, the commit-signalling store facade, the per-batch ledger, scheduler-first construction and one terminate path. B-OBSERVE-SCHEDULES is a declared bounded search over real native settlements: four fixtures (F1-F4) x every named gate point (register, park, validated, submit, and each read of the first and second collect, before and after); each schedule is recorded reached or unreachable with its ordering reason, and a fallback release is never counted as covered. B-TERM-TRIGGERS runs T1-T11 with a live descendant (T4 and T11 injected at Driver level; T8-T11 through the Driver rig's scripted controllers) and T12 in B-PROTOCOL-HOLD; T6 is recorded as having no descendant by construction. The removed-cascade mutants are in-test ablations (B-TERM-ABLATION), not registry mutants: the registry runner cannot resolve workspace packages. mutations.json, refusal-guards.json and value-cost.json stay byte-identical to B.
Fresh-clone local checks run before the CI dispatch; the CI run is the handoff evidence. No prior results reused; acceptance is not evaluated.
